spec.description: Out-of-the-box GHCR (GitHub Container Registry) connector. Resolves a durable GitHub Personal Access Token (write:packages) through the x-dapr-secret credential mechanism (leased via the connector sidecar) and shapes a data-plane ConnectorContext for OCI pull/push/list activities against ghcr.io. The plugin never sees the resolved PAT and never mints registry bearer tokens — bind hands back a binding handle the sidecar maps onto the lease, and the per-repository Layer-2 token exchange against ghcr.io/token is performed by the consuming activity (see design/architecture/registry-credential-refresh.md).
